FOREIGN COLORS | Sponsor PLAYBOOK
Research-informed application, not a proven outcome.

TITLE: Borrow meaning carefully.

IDEA: Ask which aspects of a club feel authentic to fans before building an activation. Partner with communities whose involvement adds value to their experience.

BASIS: Community and multidimensional team identity inform questions about fit.

OBJECTIVE: Understand perceived sponsor fit and whether the activation serves the intended fan community.

KPI: Perceived fit, usefulness and participation, with existing affiliation and response rate reported.

TEST: Pilot two activation concepts with comparable audiences. Ask what feels welcome, forced or irrelevant.

CAUTION: Prestige, logo recognition and genuine affinity are different outcomes. The unfinished thesis supplies no sponsor ROI forecast.

SOURCES
R02: https://doi.org/10.1123/jsm.21.3.319
R20: https://doi.org/10.1016/S1441-3523(07)70004-9
See the website evidence library for links and limitations.
